info.p: fox:column-widths and fox:column-gaps on fo:region-body: the body's columns take the given widths and gaps. First sequence: two columns of 125.45pt and 360.8pt with a 51.25pt gap in a 537.5pt body (the figures of a corpus document), eight paragraphs: the first column's flow is 125450mpt wide and fills, the second's is 360800mpt and takes the rest on the same page, every line area at its column's width. Second: three columns of 81, 58 and 336pt with 20pt gaps written as fox:column-gaps, on two pages. Third: the gaps omitted, each then column-gap (51.25pt). Fourth: widths that do not sum to the body's width are ignored with a warning and the columns are equal, 243125mpt each. Fifth: two widths on a three-column body, ignored likewise. The area tree carries columnWidths and columnGaps on the body region and the span, in millipoints.
